title: Paxos footer
description: A quiet light footer under a single hairline: five narrow columns of small link groups (grey 12px heads, slate 12px links) and a newsletter on the right with a rounded email field, fine print and a bold slate pill; below, a large mark and spaced wordmark, social icons and tiny legal links. On phones the newsletter comes first, then the groups in two columns. Links fade on hover.
notes: the email form is plain markup: wire the action prop to your own endpoint
